description: Apply a non-empty fields object to an existing object by type + id. This is a write action.
embedding_description: Update fields on an existing Zuora billing record by type and id, applying a non-empty field-value object to an Account, Subscription, Invoice, Payment, or Product. This is the field-maintenance write for a known live billing object and changes customer billing data in place.

result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the update was applied; low sensitivity (flag only, data_sensitivity 0.0).

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params: missing/unsupported type, id, or an empty/missing fields object. zuora.object_not_found: no object with that id exists. zuora.validation_failed: a field value was rejected.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: zuora.object_not_found: verify the id and type via data_query or get_object. zuora.validation_failed: check valid values for that object type.
